'''Yoshimasa Hosoya''' (Japanese: '''細谷佳正''' ''Hosoya Yoshimasa'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hosoya was born on February 10, 1982, in {{wp|Onomichi, Hiroshima}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He started his career in 2004 and has since become well known for his roles in a number of anime series, commonly sports anime. He also pursued a singing career, formerly being a part of the pop duo MaxBoys alongside fellow voice actor {{wp|Toshiki Masuda}}. Hosoya provided his voice for {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, most notably voicing motorcyclist [[Charles]]. He also voiced [[Lance]] in [[Pokémon Generations]]. Hosoya was affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Mausu Promotion}}, but is now freelancing. On April 23, 2017, he went on a temporary hiatus in order to undergo treatment for his throat, returning to work later that year.
